# i18n Non-Translated Allowlist (Technical)

This list documents string categories that may remain untranslated for technical reasons.

- File system paths and filenames.
- External service URLs and domains.
- Log channel names and event IDs.
- Raw technical tokens (extensions, MIME types, enum IDs).
- Version tags and semantic versions.
- Vendor/product proper names (unless a localized marketing label exists).
